title: Enforce settlement capability scope predicates
summary: Define and enforce stable settlement scope predicates so receipt reads and batch operations are constrained by signed scope metadata before expanding on-chain claims.
expectedFailureModes: Settlement grants remain effectively unscoped and allow arbitrary receipt reads or batch creation.
Future enforcement rejects existing grants because no explicit schema or migration path exists.
Public docs overclaim settlement isolation before dispatch-time predicates exist.
nextAction: Write settlement scope schema, implement dispatch checks for receipt reads and batch operations, and add tests that assert scope mismatches are rejected.
